text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads up — final onsite panel for SRE candidate in ~2h. Need confirmation on debrief lead + quick rubric clarification. Can someone cover if I get pulled? Candidate is 11:00am ET (8:00am PT).
Priya (Recruiter): I can run the debrief if needed but I'm on a short on-call tilt 3–4pm PT. Who else is joining?
Samir (Eng): I can be debrief lead if Priya can't. Quick question — are we using 1–5 or 1–4 scoring? The calendar notes 1–4 in one place.
Maya (People Ops): Use 1–5. People Ops canonical scale is 1 (poor) — 5 (exceeds). Sorry for the mismatch in the invite. Tie-breaker rule: product-fit weight first, then hiring manager follow-up.
Aisha (Staff SRE): FYI timezone check — I can join but prefer not to be debrief lead. 8:00am PT is fine for me.
Priya (Recruiter): Samir, if you're lead can you assign a scribe in the shared doc? Link in the calendar — I’ll post again: https://redwood-internal/panels/7501234567
Samir (Eng): Assigned scribe — tagging @Aisha as primary scribe. Aisha — ok to capture notes and scores?
Aisha (Staff SRE): I can scribe but may need to drop at ~9:10am PT. I'll capture core notes + scores while I'm there.
Maya (People Ops): If Aisha needs to drop, we need a backup to finalize the debrief within 30m. @Priya — can you consolidate with the hiring manager afterward?
Priya (Recruiter): Yes I'll pull final notes and do the HM handoff. Also — recording consent: calendar says candidate consented but please confirm verbally at start.
Maya (People Ops): Reminder: ask consent at the top. Small rubric clarification — under "system design" please call out inference-serving concerns (latency, fallbacks) where relevant; that’s part of the score.
Samir (Eng): Noted. Any accessibility/accommodation items we should enable?
Priya (Recruiter): Candidate requested live captions. Please enable Zoom captions and note in the doc.
InterviewBot: Reminder: panel checklist — recording: ENABLED, captions: ENABLED, shared doc: /panels/7501234567, meeting link present.
Maya (People Ops): One last procedural ask — if scores diverge by >=2 points, default next step is immediate sync with the hiring manager within 24h. Everyone okay with that?
Samir (Eng): Yep, fine with that. See you all in ~30m. :thumbsup:
Priya (Recruiter): Thanks, team. Will ping in 15 for final confirmations.
Aisha (Staff SRE): On it, will prep scribe header and scoring table now.
